ctx.x: The drummer, yeah, he was a great friend. And he was cool about all kinds of things. And he worked with George Wein and the Newport All Stars, like he was the road manager. And he was just this great guy. So he was in Europe and he had played on the same stage with some group like, who was that saxophone quartet, you know, the very modern one.
